name: Duro Beach Lounge
summary: Restaurante e bar aberto ao público, à beira-mar, com pratos locais e internacionais, petiscos, coquetéis e açaí.
descriptionHtml:
Duro Beach Lounge sits directly on Cumbuco beach and combines a restaurant, bar, beach seating, and ocean views. Its official site describes local and international dishes, appetizers, cocktails, juices, and açaí.

Opening patterns and events can change. Check the official website directly before planning a special visit.

images.alt: Tables beneath palm trees at Duro Beach Lounge in Cumbuco

location.address: Rua Beatriz Correia, 64, Praia do Cumbuco, Caucaia, Ceará

openingHours: Official website states that the restaurant opens daily; confirm current service hours directly.
